**In one line**: OpenAI's Hollywood-style entertainment push reportedly fell apart in under six months, and Google is said to be moving into the space with ambitions of its own.

### Key points
- OpenAI's entertainment and video-related initiative reportedly stalled less than six months after launch.
- Google is said to be stepping into the resulting gap with plans of its own.
- The original report (The Times of India) does not spell out concrete details on scope, scale, or timing.

### Why it matters
As AI video generation pushes toward real film and content production, a front-runner stumbling while a rival moves in signals that this market is still unsettled. With limited detail available so far, these reports should be treated as developing rather than confirmed.
